summary: Source-grounded V1.5 audit of repeated per-attempt startup work and Studio-wide quality/security/throughput risks. Proposed versioned per-job resume capsules, repo-level source map, one shift preflight, change-delta retrieval, canonical attempt receipt with derived projections, selective QA packets, per-path lease scheduling, and measured worker utilization. Live main evolved to include merged PR29 reconciliation import fix, but successful subsequent scheduled execution not verified. Found latent studio.py:record config NameError on valid code SUBMITTED path, ACK projector lacking recipient epoch binding, serialized comms Actions queue, full-history inbox replay, limited S slots vs 1024 CW registry, and no independently authenticated executions/shift controller. No source code, PRs or permissions changed.
